channel.title: IndieHOT — Indie Game Hot Topics
channel.description: IndieHOT collects indie game news from a set of public sources every day and scores it by rules: engines & tools, publishing & marketing, devlogs, industry & funding, events, reviews & postmortems. Only titles, one-line self-written summaries and outbound links are shown — no full text is republished.

item.title: Mastering Steamworks: A Technical Guide for Indie Publishing
item.description: A hands-on technical guide that breaks down the Steamworks APIs and tools to help indie developers get publishing, player experience and discoverability right.

item.title: Download Rank Isn't Revenue: What 90 Days of App Store Charts Say About Mobile Games
item.description: Recording App Store charts in 170+ countries every day, the author shows how a game can lose most of its new players and still keep its revenue — three cases that expose the real gap between download rank and actual income.

item.title: Resident Evil 4 remake dominates current-gen remake sales with 16.8M copies, Steam's long tail powers revenue
item.description: New estimates from market analysis firm Alinea put Resident Evil 4 remake at 16.8 million copies sold, with Steam's long tail doing much of the revenue work.

item.title: How a Rust civ sim stays deterministic with WebAssembly SIMD and threads
item.description: A browser civilization sim written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly; the author breaks down the fixed tick order and spatial indexing that keep the world evolving identically with SIMD or threads enabled.

item.title: Ensō Engine 1.1: a free Blender build for anime and NPR
item.description: Mix 3D Design released Ensō Engine 1.1, a free open-source Blender build tailored for anime and non-photorealistic rendering.

item.title: Localizing a Game for Turkish: the Dotted I, Suffixes on Placeholders and Other Engine Problems
item.description: Turkish looks like an easy Latin-alphabet locale until misspelled menus, broken item messages, and crashes only Turkish players can reproduce show up — the article unpacks each engineering pitfall.

item.title: Tencent's Morefun Studios Unveils a New Action Battle-Royale Game Built to Let More Players Show Off
item.description: Tencent's Morefun Studios announced Shou, a UE5 multiplayer action game with a low-floor, high-ceiling dual-weapon combat system, 1v1 duels and a three-player battle-royale mode, playable across PC and mobile.

item.title: How I Built a Daily Chart-Guessing Game on Reddit (And Why the Crowd Keeps Winning)
item.description: The author looks back at a daily chart-guessing game built on Reddit — scoring zero on day two — and unpacks the design pitfalls of data-visualization games and the wisdom of the crowd.

item.title: Ludo.ai launches AI-powered Tileset Generator for 2D game development
item.description: Describe a tileset in words and get a full set of 2D map tiles, a handy new tool for pixel-art and top-down level work.

item.title: Running a Two-Week Character Style Test Before You Commit to Stylised or Realistic
item.description: Many small teams settle their character style in a single meeting; the author suggests a structured two-week style test before committing, so the choice doesn't lock in hiring, tools and the publisher pitch too early.

item.title: Roblox signs music licensing agreement with PRS for Music
item.description: Roblox signs a music licensing deal with UK rights body PRS for Music, opening a new revenue stream for songwriters and publishers whose music is used on the platform, with royalty payments starting in 2027.

item.title: 5 things I learned building a 3D map editor in Rust with Bevy
item.description: The author spent months building Fiza3D, a desktop 3D map editor for game levels, roads, and cities in Rust on Bevy, and shares five lessons for anyone wanting to build a similar tool.

item.title: This Tool Brings 2D Painting Workflows Into Unreal Engine 5
item.description: Inky recreates traditional painting materials inside Unreal Engine 5, letting artists paint 3D assets with a 2D workflow.

item.title: Sensor Tower introduces web store revenue estimates
item.description: Sensor Tower now estimates direct-to-consumer web store revenue, giving developers a fuller picture of app and game monetisation beyond the stores.

item.title: Flutter Flame Tutorial: Build Your First 2D Game (Beginner Guide)
item.description: If you already know Flutter, you're closer to shipping your first game than you think — this beginner guide walks you through building a 2D game with the Flame engine.

item.title: Unreal Engine 6 won't include Blueprints or Actor Gameplay Framework
item.description: Epic confirms Unreal Engine 6 will drop Blueprints and the Actor Gameplay Framework in favor of Verse and the new Scene Graph framework, marking a major shift in engine workflow.

item.title: Data digest: Monopoly Go hits $8bn, Block Blast and Vita Mahjong lead ad charts, Korea stats, more
item.description: This week's mobile data round-up: Monopoly Go passes $8bn in revenue, Block Blast and Vita Mahjong top the ad charts, plus Korea market stats and more revenue news.

item.title: Colossal Order's CEO on data, gut feeling and why "a game for everyone is a game for no one"
item.description: Colossal Order's CEO reflects on how the studio picks games that keep finding their audience: her first answer was gut feeling, until she looked closer at what really guided those choices.

item.title: Learn How To Create This Colorful Cel Shader in Blender 5.3
item.description: Using Blender 5.3's new Light Accumulation node, the author walks through the full workflow for building a colorful cel shader.

item.title: Finding Minecraft Slime Chunks in Python and JavaScript (Reproducing Java's Random)
item.description: Slime chunks come down to a small formula built on java.util.Random — the author reproduces it in Python and JavaScript and explains how seed tools work under the hood.
